stories.summary: Prime Minister Donald Tusk strongly criticized President Karol Nawrocki and former President Andrzej Duda for their response to controversial remarks by US President Trump about NATO soldiers in Afghanistan. Tusk said their role is not to lobby for other countries, even closest allies, but to guard Polish national dignity.

stories.headline: Court dismisses Kaczyński defamation case due to minimal harm
stories.summary: A Warsaw court dismissed the defamation case brought by Civic Coalition MEP Krzysztof Brejza against PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński. While the court found Kaczyński's statements met the criteria for defamation, it dismissed the case due to minimal social harm. The case concerned Kaczyński's March 2024 statements about Brejza before the Pegasus commission.

stories.summary: Sławomir Mentzen announced that his Nowa Nadzieja party will merge with the newly created Imperium Kontratakuje party at a February 21 congress in Warsaw. The merger aims to resolve legal problems facing Nowa Nadzieja after a court decision to remove it from the party register due to financial reporting failures.

stories.headline: NBP world leader in gold purchases for second consecutive year

NBP Governor Adam Glapiński defends the policy as building credibility and security, though some economists question the returns compared to other investments.
